records.observation: Entire 213-line class declares UI constants: font SansSerif plain 10, zoom limits 0/30, ruler/panel/infobox time patterns #,##0.00###### / #,##0.00######## / #,##0.000000####, integer #,##0, float 0.0##, short ##0, indentation 5, initial scroll unit 10, resource roots /images/ and /html/. Static initializer sets STRING_FORMAT and BOOLEAN_FORMAT null, matching LabeledTextField nonnumeric constructor mode (numeric getters then cannot assume a formatter). Creates shared Alias objects for RenderingHints antialias default/off/on and Color black/darkGray/gray/lightGray/white with labels default/off/on and black/dark gray/gray/light gray/white. Parsers call input.equalsIgnoreCase on exact labels in that order; no trimming. Unknown nonnull input silently returns default antialias or black; null throws before fallback. Thus DARK GRAY accepted, darkgray or padded dark gray falls back to black. Returns shared Alias identities, no new values or arbitrary color parsing. Constructor only Object init. Constants do not themselves enforce zoom limits or load resources; callers remain separate evidence. Static bytecode reading only; no archived execution or independent semantic approval.
